svg.title: Three-Quarter, Open Jaw — Temporomandibular joint
svg.desc: Fig. 2 — Three-quarter view; the mandible opens about the temporomandibular joint. Colour plate. Exported from a Lámina living plate.

g.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', 'EB Garamond', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Fig. 2 — Three-quarter view; the mandible opens about the temporomandibular joint.

g.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.title: Temporalis — Fans from the temple under the arch to the coronoid process.
g.text: Temporalis — Fans from the temple under the arch to the coronoid
process.

g.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.title: Masseter — From the zygomatic arch to the angle: the strongest closer.
g.text: Masseter — From the zygomatic arch to the angle: the strongest closer.

g.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.title: Frontal bone — The forehead and the roofs of both orbits.
g.text: Frontal bone — The forehead and the roofs of both orbits.

g.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.title: Parietal bone — Paired plates that make the roof and sides of the vault.
g.text: Parietal bone — Paired plates that make the roof and sides of the
vault.

g.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.title: Temporal bone — Houses the ear and carries the jaw joint.
g.text: Temporal bone — Houses the ear and carries the jaw joint.

g.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.title: Occipital bone — Back and base of the skull, around the foramen magnum.
g.text: Occipital bone — Back and base of the skull, around the foramen
magnum.

g.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.title: Sphenoid — A butterfly-shaped keystone bone; its greater wing shows at the temple.
g.text: Sphenoid — A butterfly-shaped keystone bone; its greater wing shows at
the temple.

g.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.title: Zygomatic bone — The cheekbone: lateral rim and part of the floor of the orbit.
g.text: Zygomatic bone — The cheekbone: lateral rim and part of the floor of
the orbit.

g.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.title: Maxilla — The upper jaw: holds the upper teeth and frames the nasal aperture.
g.text: Maxilla — The upper jaw: holds the upper teeth and frames the nasal
aperture.

g.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.title: Nasal bones — Two small bones that form the bridge of the nose.
g.text: Nasal bones — Two small bones that form the bridge of the nose.

g.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.title: Mandible — The lower jaw — the only movable bone of the skull.
g.text: Mandible — The lower jaw — the only movable bone of the skull.

g.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.title: Orbit — Eye socket, about 4 cm wide and 3.4 cm high; seven bones meet in its walls.
g.text: Orbit — Eye socket, about 4 cm wide and 3.4 cm high; seven bones meet
in its walls.

g.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.title: Piriform aperture — The pear-shaped opening of the nasal cavity.
g.text: Piriform aperture — The pear-shaped opening of the nasal cavity.

g.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.title: Zygomatic arch — A bony bridge from cheek to temple; the masseter hangs from it.
g.text: Zygomatic arch — A bony bridge from cheek to temple; the masseter
hangs from it.

g.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.title: Mastoid process — Behind the ear; anchors the sternocleidomastoid muscle.
g.text: Mastoid process — Behind the ear; anchors the sternocleidomastoid
muscle.

g.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.title: Condyle — Head of the mandible: hinges and glides in the jaw joint.
g.text: Condyle — Head of the mandible: hinges and glides in the jaw joint.

g.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.title: Coronoid process — Thin blade of the mandible where the temporalis attaches.
g.text: Coronoid process — Thin blade of the mandible where the temporalis
attaches.

g.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.title: Teeth — Adults have 32: per quadrant 2 incisors, 1 canine, 2 premolars, 3 molars.
g.text: Teeth — Adults have 32: per quadrant 2 incisors, 1 canine, 2
premolars, 3 molars.

g.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.title: Coronal suture — Joins the frontal bone to both parietals across the crown.
g.text: Coronal suture — Joins the frontal bone to both parietals across the
crown.

g.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.title: Sagittal suture — Joins the two parietals along the midline.
g.text: Sagittal suture — Joins the two parietals along the midline.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: CALAVERAS · JOSOROMA · LÁMINA NATURAL HISTORY PRESS
